title: atlas.contract.describe.v1 — arguments
description: Return the running contract: revision, protocol revision, record schemas, tool list, live vocabularies, transport-invariant limits, machine-readable deprecations, and the history block. Call this first. Validate against the vocabularies it returns, not against a copy captured when your client shipped.

revision.description: Ask for a specific revision. Absent means the current one. A revision this server does not serve is a typed refusal, never a silent substitution.
